---
title: "tidyr"
---

The tidyr functions use tidyr's argument names in camelCase, and tidyr's
dot-arguments take a leading underscore. See
[Underscored arguments](../coming-from-dplyr.qmd#underscored-arguments).

## Pivoting

`pivot_longer(cols)` turns the selected columns into rows of names and values.

| Option | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `namesTo` | `'name'` | Column, or columns, for the names. `'.value'` takes a value column's name from that part. |
| `valuesTo` | `'value'` | Column for the values |
| `namesPrefix` | none | Regular expression removed from the start of each name |
| `namesSep`, `namesPattern` | none | Split names into several `namesTo` columns, by separator or by regex groups |
| `valuesDropNa` | `false` | Drop rows whose values are all NA |
| `namesTransform`, `valuesTransform` | none | A closure, or an array of closures by column |
| `colsVary` | `'fastest'` | `'slowest'` keeps each source column's rows together |

`pivot_wider()` spreads names and values into columns.

| Option | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `namesFrom`, `valuesFrom` | `'name'`, `'value'` | Columns that supply the new names and their values |
| `idCols` | every other column | Columns that identify the output rows |
| `valuesFill` | NA | Value for missing cells |
| `valuesFn` | none | Combines duplicate cells |
| `namesPrefix`, `namesSep`, `namesGlue`, `namesSort` | `''`, `'_'`, none, `false` | Control the new names |
| `namesVary` | `'fastest'` | `'slowest'` groups each name's value columns together |
| `namesExpand`, `idExpand` | `false` | Add every combination of the `namesFrom` or `idCols` values, sorted, factors by level |
| `unusedFn` | none | Summarizes columns in none of `idCols`, `namesFrom`, and `valuesFrom` |

Without `valuesFn`, duplicate cells turn the value columns into list-columns
and trigger a PHP warning with tidyr's message.

`build_longer_spec()` and `build_wider_spec()` return tidyr's pivot spec as a
table, and `pivot_longer_spec()` and `pivot_wider_spec()` run an edited one.
The superseded `gather()` and `spread()` are also available.

{{< include ../examples/_pivot.md >}}

## Missing combinations and values

`complete()` adds missing combinations of the given columns and fills other
columns with NA, or with values from `fill:`. A column name expands to its
unique values (a factor to its levels), `nesting()` keeps only combinations
that occur, and a named list supplies the values. It works within groups.
`expand()` returns only the combinations, and `crossing()` and `expand_grid()`
build a new table from lists.

{{< include ../examples/_complete.md >}}

`fill()` carries values down or up over NA within groups
(`_direction: 'down' | 'up' | 'downup' | 'updown'`). `drop_na()` drops rows
with NA in the given columns, and `replace_na()` replaces NA per column.

{{< include ../examples/_fill.md >}}

## Splitting and combining

| Function | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `separate_wider_delim(col, delim, names:)` | Split on a fixed string into columns |
| `separate_wider_position(col, widths)` | Split by character widths |
| `separate_wider_regex(col, patterns)` | Split with named regular expressions |
| `separate_longer_delim(col, delim)` | Split into rows |
| `separate_longer_position(col, width)` | Split into rows of fixed width |
| `separate(col, into, sep:)` | The superseded splitter, with `extra`, `fill`, and `convert` |
| `unite(col, ...cols, sep:)` | Paste columns together |
| `uncount('n', _id:)` | Repeat rows by a weight column |
| `separate_rows(...cols, sep:)` | The superseded row splitter, on a regular expression |
| `extract(col, into, regex)` | The superseded regex splitter |
| `nest(data: [...])`, `unnest('data')` | List-columns of tables |
| `full_seq(x, period)` | Every value from the smallest to the largest in steps of `period` |

`tooFew` and `tooMany` handle pieces that don't fit, as in tidyr.

{{< include ../examples/_separate.md >}}

## List-columns

A list element is a PHP array. A list is R's unnamed list or vector, and an
array with string keys is a named list.

| Function | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `unnest_wider(col, namesSep:)` | One column per name; unnamed elements need `namesSep` |
| `unnest_longer(col, valuesTo:, indicesTo:, indicesInclude:, keepEmpty:)` | One row per element, with names or positions in `{col}_id` |
| `hoist(col, name: path, _remove:)` | Pull components out by name, 1-based position, or a list path |
| `chop(cols)`, `unchop(cols, keepEmpty:)` | Collapse rows into list-columns and back |
| `pack(name: cols, _namesSep:)`, `unpack(cols, namesSep:)` | Columns into a column of named arrays and back |

`chop`, `pack`, `unpack`, and `extract` share names with PHP built-ins, so
import them with `use function Phplyr\{chop, pack, unpack, extract};`.
